# pgsql

```go
import "github.com/effective-security/trustyca/internal/db/pgsql"
```

Package pgsql implements the database interfaces of internal/db on PostgreSQL.

Provider wraps an xdb.Provider; every method builds its SQL through the query package, measures the query and maps a missing row to xdb.ErrorNotFound. A method that writes more than one row \(AcceptInvite, RegisterCertificate with an event, RegisterIssuer with an anchor, RevokeCertificate, PublishCrl\) opens a transaction with BeginTx and runs every statement on the provider it returns:

```
tx, err := p.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
defer tx.Close() // rolls back unless committed
txProvider := tx.(*Provider)
```

Lists page by offset or by a keyset cursor on their sort key \(listRows\): id for the CA lists, \(created\_at, id\) for the events, \(name, id\) for the orgs and the projects. The tests need the configured local PostgreSQL database.

## Constants

<a name="UniqueIssuerLabel"></a>The unique constraints of the CA tables, as PostgreSQL names them in a violation \(SQLSTATE 23505\)

```go
const (
    // UniqueIssuerLabel is the label of an issuer in its org and project
    UniqueIssuerLabel = "unique_issuer_org_project_label"
    // UniqueIssuerSkid is the key identifier of an issuer, across the table
    UniqueIssuerSkid = "unique_issuer_skid"
    // UniqueCertificatePrefix is the prefix of the unique constraints of the
    // certificate table: the thumbprint, and the issuer and serial pair
    UniqueCertificatePrefix = "unique_certificate"
)
```

<a name="DefaultInviteExpiry"></a>DefaultInviteExpiry is the validity of an invite when the caller does not set ExpiresAt

```go
const DefaultInviteExpiry = 14 * 24 * time.Hour
```

## Variables

<a name="DbSlowMethodMilliseconds"></a>DbSlowMethodMilliseconds defines the maximum number of Milliseconds to define a DB operation slow

```go
var DbSlowMethodMilliseconds = 500
```

<a name="ErrAlreadyRevoked"></a>ErrAlreadyRevoked is returned by RevokeCertificate for a certificate whose status is Revoked

```go
var ErrAlreadyRevoked = errors.New("certificate is already revoked")
```

<a name="ErrRootConflict"></a>ErrRootConflict is returned by RegisterRoot when the certificate is registered in another scope: the thumbprint is unique across the table

```go
var ErrRootConflict = errors.New("root certificate is registered in another scope")
```

<a name="ErrStaleCrlNumber"></a>ErrStaleCrlNumber is returned by PublishCrl when the CRL number is not greater than the issuer's current one: another publisher won, and the caller signs a new CRL with the next number

```go
var ErrStaleCrlNumber = errors.New("crl number is not greater than the issuer's crl number")
```

<a name="IsUniqueViolation"></a>
## func [IsUniqueViolation](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/internal/db/pgsql/errors.go#L34>)

```go
func IsUniqueViolation(err error, prefix string) bool
```

IsUniqueViolation reports whether the error is a unique constraint violation of a constraint whose name starts with the prefix; an empty prefix matches every unique constraint. The driver's error is matched by its SQLSTATE and constraint name; an error that only carries the driver's message, as the fakes of the tests return, by the message.

<a name="Provider.AcceptInvite"></a>
### func \(\*Provider\) [AcceptInvite](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/internal/db/pgsql/invite.go#L150>)

```go
func (p *Provider) AcceptInvite(ctx context.Context, inviteID, userID uint64) (*model.Membership, error)
```

AcceptInvite accepts an invite for a user, adds the user as a member at the invite's scope with the invited role, and removes the invite.

<a name="Provider.AcceptInvites"></a>
### func \(\*Provider\) [AcceptInvites](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/internal/db/pgsql/invite.go#L224>)

```go
func (p *Provider) AcceptInvites(ctx context.Context, user *model.User) (model.MembershipSlice, error)
```

AcceptInvites moves the pending invites for a user's email to grants at the invites' scopes, and returns the grants it created. Each invite is accepted in a transaction of its own: an invite whose grant fails is logged, stays pending and is not returned, and one withdrawn since the list is not found and grants nothing.

<a name="Provider.ActivateIssuer"></a>
### func \(\*Provider\) [ActivateIssuer](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/internal/db/pgsql/issuer.go#L173>)

```go
func (p *Provider) ActivateIssuer(ctx context.Context, m *model.Issuer) (*model.Issuer, error)
```

ActivateIssuer sets the certificate columns of a Pending issuer from the model, clears its CSR and makes it Active. The issuer is reported as not found when it does not exist, is not Pending or is not of the model's org.

<a name="Provider.BeginTx"></a>
### func \(\*Provider\) [BeginTx](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/internal/db/pgsql/provider.go#L64>)

```go
func (p *Provider) BeginTx(ctx context.Context, opts *sql.TxOptions) (xdb.Provider, error)
```

BeginTx starts a transaction.

The provided context is used until the transaction is committed or rolled back. If the context is cancelled, the sql package will roll back the transaction. Tx.Commit will return an error if the context provided to BeginTx is cancelled.

The provided TxOptions is optional and may be nil if defaults should be used. If a non\-default isolation level is used that the driver doesn't support, an error will be returned.

<a name="Provider.DeleteCertificate"></a>
### func \(\*Provider\) [DeleteCertificate](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/internal/db/pgsql/certificate.go#L235>)

```go
func (p *Provider) DeleteCertificate(ctx context.Context, orgID, id uint64) (int64, error)
```

DeleteCertificate deletes a certificate of the exact org scope \(a zero orgID is the platform\) and its revocation, and returns the number of deleted certificates. Certificates are audit records: the retention task and operators delete them, the tenant lifecycle does not.


<a name="Provider.DeleteExpiredCertificates"></a>
### func \(\*Provider\) [DeleteExpiredCertificates](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/internal/db/pgsql/certificate.go#L271>)

```go
func (p *Provider) DeleteExpiredCertificates(ctx context.Context, req *query.DeleteExpiredCertificatesRequest) (int64, error)
```

DeleteExpiredCertificates deletes a batch of certificates of any status whose validity ended before the time, with their revocations, lowest IDs first, and returns the number of deleted certificates. The caller repeats the call until a batch is smaller than the limit. Retention is the only deletion of certificates the service performs itself.

<a name="Provider.PublishCrl"></a>
### func \(\*Provider\) [PublishCrl](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/internal/db/pgsql/crl.go#L27>)

```go
func (p *Provider) PublishCrl(ctx context.Context, m *model.Crl) (*model.Crl, error)
```

PublishCrl stores the current CRL of an issuer and records its number on the issuer in one transaction. The CRL's IKID must be the issuer's SKID and the number greater than the issuer's current CRL number, so the number of an IKID only grows: otherwise nothing is stored and ErrStaleCrlNumber is returned. The tenancy and issuer name of the CRL are copied from the issuer row.

<a name="Provider.QueryContext"></a>

```go

```

QueryContext executes a query that returns rows, typically a SELECT. The args are for any placeholder parameters in the query.

<a name="Provider.QueryRowContext"></a>
### func \(\*Provider\) [QueryRowContext](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/internal/db/pgsql/provider.go#L113>)

```go
func (p *Provider) QueryRowContext(ctx context.Context, query string, args ...any) *sql.Row
```

QueryRowContext executes a query that is expected to return at most one row. QueryRowContext always returns a non\-nil value. Errors are deferred until Row's Scan method is called. If the query selects no rows, the \*Row's Scan will return ErrNoRows. Otherwise, the \*Row's Scan scans the first selected row and discards the rest.

<a name="Provider.RegisterAPIKey"></a>
### func \(\*Provider\) [RegisterAPIKey](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/internal/db/pgsql/apikey.go#L18>)

```go
func (p *Provider) RegisterAPIKey(ctx context.Context, m *model.APIKey) (*model.APIKey, error)
```

<a name="Provider.RegisterCertificate"></a>
### func \(\*Provider\) [RegisterCertificate](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/internal/db/pgsql/certificate.go#L22>)

```go
func (p *Provider) RegisterCertificate(ctx context.Context, m *model.Certificate, evt *model.Event) (*model.Certificate, error)
```

RegisterCertificate inserts the issuance record of a certificate; the status defaults to Active. The thumbprint and the issuer and serial number pair are unique. With an event, the insert and the event are one transaction, and the event references the certificate when it has no reference of its own.

<a name="Provider.RegisterIssuer"></a>
### func \(\*Provider\) [RegisterIssuer](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/internal/db/pgsql/issuer.go#L25>)

```go
func (p *Provider) RegisterIssuer(ctx context.Context, m *model.Issuer, anchor *model.RootCertificate) (*model.Issuer, error)
```

RegisterIssuer inserts an issuer. A Pending issuer carries its CSR, any other status its certificate; the label is unique in its scope and the SKID across the table. A root issuer requires its anchor, its own certificate as a trust anchor of its org, which is registered as RegisterRoot does in the transaction of the insert, so a root issuer is never stored without it; any other issuer takes none. An anchor registered in another scope fails both with ErrRootConflict.

<a name="Provider.RegisterOrg"></a>

```go
func (p *Provider) RegisterOrg(ctx context.Context, m *model.Org, ownerID uint64) (*model.Org, error)
```

RegisterOrg registers a new org and, when ownerID is set, its Owner in one transaction: an org is never left without its Owner

<a name="Provider.RegisterProfile"></a>

```go
func (p *Provider) RegisterProfile(ctx context.Context, m *model.CertificateProfile) (*model.CertificateProfile, error)
```

RegisterProfile creates a certificate profile, or replaces the issuer label, status and config of the profile with the same label in the same scope; the row ID and creation time of a replaced profile are kept

<a name="Provider.RegisterProject"></a>
### func \(\*Provider\) [RegisterProject](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/internal/db/pgsql/project.go#L17>)

```go
func (p *Provider) RegisterProject(ctx context.Context, m *model.Project) (*model.Project, error)
```

RegisterProject creates a project in an org

<a name="Provider.RegisterRoot"></a>
### func \(\*Provider\) [RegisterRoot](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/internal/db/pgsql/root.go#L21>)

```go
func (p *Provider) RegisterRoot(ctx context.Context, m *model.RootCertificate) (*model.RootCertificate, error)
```

RegisterRoot registers a trust anchor. Registering the same certificate again in the same scope updates its trust and returns the existing row; the same certificate in another scope fails with ErrRootConflict.

<a name="Provider.RevokeCertificate"></a>


RevokeCertificate records the revocation of a certificate of the exact org scope and sets its status to Revoked in one transaction. The revocation copies the issuer, serial number, expiry and tenancy of the certificate row.
